purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: Official county cadastral service metadata described a polygon layer and safe Parcel_Key field. Exact WUP point intersection returned an empty FeatureCollection. A single 25 m point-distance query returned three polygon geometries, all with Parcel_Key=null, and properties.exceededTransferLimit=true. No sensitive fields were requested. The exact centroid query had no intersecting parcel. The bounded nearby response was transfer-limited and contained null Parcel_Key values, so native parcel identity and query completeness remain unverified.
registryAssessment: Milwaukee County Land Information Office publishes a county cadastral parcel layer covering municipalities including Milwaukee. Safe schema inspection identified Polygon geometry and Parcel_Key; tax keys and unrelated fields were excluded. The bounded query returned nearby geometry but Parcel_Key was null in all returned features; the transfer-limit flag means this partial response does not establish full local coverage.
